It is known for its high THC content, typically ranging between 22-30%, and its potent effects The buds of Twisted Cookies are often small to medium in size and have a dense, popcorn-like structure. They are usually a bright green color with orange hairs and a thick coating of resinous trichomes. The aroma of Twisted Cookies is a mix of sweet and spicy with notes of cherries and earthiness. 

When consumed, Twisted Cookies produce a strong and fast-acting high that is both cerebral and physical. The effects are often described as euphoric and uplifting, with a strong sense of relaxation and a feeling of creative inspiration. As the high progresses, the physical effects may become more pronounced, leading to a deep relaxation that can be
sedative in higher doses. Twisted Cookies is often used by those looking for relief from chronic
pain, anxiety, and depression, as well as for relaxation and stress relief. However, as with all strains of cannabis, individual experiences may vary based on factors such as dosage, tolerance, and personal physiology.

name: Stündenglass Kompact Gravity Infuser - Black
description:
Introducing the newest sensation from Stündenglass, the Kompact Gravity Infuser. The Kompact features the same patented 360° gravity system, dynamic design, and immersive experience as the original, now available in a more refined, portable size that includes a custom-fit travel case.

Coming in at just under a foot tall, the Kompact is exactly what you need to enjoy the benefits of Stündenglass in an easy to handle package. The smaller globes hold about two thirds of the volume, or 2 cups, compared to the full size, which creates cooler and faster pulls.

The travel case is carefully crafted with high grade fabric and form-fitted to cradle the Kompact Stündenglass, which arrives full assembled. A beautiful metal inlayed logo plate adorns the front with an easy to use zipper, carrying handle and strap for over the shoulder use. Designed for functional versatility, the Kompact Gravity Infuser is a complete set that includes an aluminum bowl kit and a glass liner but can also connect to any smoking or vaporization device with a 14mm male joint. Also included is a 3-foot silicone hose that can be connected to the 45° adjustable mouthpiece for direct draws or a steady stream of smoke for contactless consumption. 

The Kompact is a sophisticated and elegantly designed 360° rotating glass device that generates kinetic motion activation via cascading water displacement, opposing airflow technology, and the natural force of gravity. It is constructed using the highest quality materials, including borosilicate glass globes and aircraft-grade anodized aluminum.

Covered under US Patent Numbers: 12,035,752, D943,817, D970,804, Canada Industrial Design Patent Numbers 200939, 215021, EUIPO 008421937-0001 and other foreign and domestic patents pending.

3 joints in 1, without the rolling hassle

Let me put it like this: the money, time, and effort you’d usually spend rolling 2-3 joints is much more than you think. Fits: 1-2 grams (perfect for on-the-go)
Cure time: 30 minutes recommended (If you pack thoroughly, no cure is needed)
Smokes: Up to 30 minutes solo (dependent on how many people smoking and how heavy your lungs are)

name: 2PK LIVE RESIN | Hash Burger | .5g 510 Cart
description:
MF-ing Two-Fer: We're now offering two 1/2g carts in one bag. Why? Pouring less oil into one cart means we can preserve more of the plant’s full spectrum cannabinoids, remarkable natural terpenes and fuller flavor. Not only that, the Two-Fer is better value and more of our single-source, in-house produced Hash Burger real live resin: the unmistakable sweet yet spicy and lemony, finished off by woody pine and fresh flower notes; known to promote emotional balance and improved appetite with long-lasting, invigorating cerebral effects that spread to your whole body.

For our real live resin we start with fresh-frozen flower buds, then use the hydrocarbon
extraction method (plus years of experience and scientific precision) to deliver the purest plant
extract. No distillates, added flavors, or alterations.

Comes in a 510 Cart with recommended battery settings 2.8 - 3.3V. Do not vaporize live resin at
higher temperatures, as it can “burn off” the precious terpenes and aromas we are working
hard to preserve; higher temps can also cause an undesirable “burnt” aftertaste. Vape cartridge
contains concentrated live resin oil that is heated by a battery and vaporized for inhalation.
These products are very potent and are designed to be consumed in 2-3 second puffs.

description:
At MFNY, we make RiverwayTM Live Rosin in a specific way that preserves powerful plant characteristics. We do this to highlight the difference between “real” live rosin and misleading alternatives on store shelves. Riverway isn’t just a name, it’s a promise to make products all New Yorkers can be proud of. 
Candy Rain Riverway Live Rosin badder is a premium concentrate that is created with a proprietary cultivation, freezing, and extraction process designed to preserve flavor, maximize potency, and ensure a truly solventless experience. It starts with our best, in-house grown, bred, and fresh-frozen Candy Rain buds. We flash freeze our plants right after meticulous harvest preparation to lock in all the trichome-and-terpene-rich goodness of the plant (this is the “Live” part of Resin), and pull from only the best micron range.
Candy Rain is known for its sweet candy aroma and flavor. Potent in THC, it promotes a relaxing body high with long-lasting, invigorating cerebral effects that spread to your whole body. Riverway Live Rosin badder concentrate has a soft, butter-like texture for an easy-to-use, super enjoyable experience. Our Riverway Live Rosin concentrates are exclusively single-source and produced at the highest of standards in our next generation laboratory space, using scientific precision and years of experience, which we’ve proudly gathered together in New York's Hudson Valley.

description:
Smoothie Bar Disposable 2G – Peanut Butter Breath x Zacks Pie is a premium hybrid vape that combines two beloved genetics into a flavor-packed, high-performance disposable experience. This 2-gram Smoothie Bar is crafted for consumers who want a rich, dessert-inspired inhale followed by potent, balanced effects. By fusing the creamy, nutty sweetness of Peanut Butter Breath with the fruity, pie-like complexity of Zacks Pie, this disposable delivers a smooth flavor journey that feels indulgent and satisfying from start to finish.

On the palate, Peanut Butter Breath takes the lead with its signature roasted peanut, earthy, and lightly sweet profile, creating a smooth, almost butter-like inhale that’s rich but not heavy. As the vapor unfolds, Zacks Pie introduces layered fruitiness and subtle spice, reminiscent of a fresh-baked dessert with hints of berry and citrus. Together, these terpenes produce a balanced yet exciting combination, appealing to both flavor chasers and those seeking something beyond standard vape profiles. The terpenes are preserved to maintain clarity and depth, ensuring each hit tastes full and vibrant rather than muted or artificial.

The effects of the Peanut Butter Breath x Zacks Pie blend are equally compelling. Users typically report a gentle cerebral uplift that enhances mood and focus, paired with a relaxing body sensation that eases tension without dragging you down. It’s the kind of hybrid high that works well for social settings, creative activities, or leisurely evenings when you want to unwind while staying functional. The blend’s balance makes it approachable for both newer consumers and seasoned enthusiasts who appreciate nuanced effects.

Built with a high-capacity 2-gram chamber and a draw-activated firing mechanism, the Smoothie Bar Disposable is designed for convenience and reliability. There’s no button to press — just inhale and enjoy clean, consistent vapor production throughout the life of the unit. The sleek form factor fits comfortably in your hand or pocket, making it ideal for on-the-go sessions or everyday use.

In summary, the Smoothie Bar Disposable 2G Peanut Butter Breath x Zacks Pie vape is a standout choice for anyone looking for a deliciously complex flavor profile paired with versatile hybrid effects. With its dessert-inspired taste, smooth draw, and well-rounded high, it delivers a premium vape experience that lives up to the Smoothie Bar reputation for quality and innovation.

name: Brain Wash | Indoor | 3.5g
description:
Brain Wash | Indoor | 3.5g

Your favorite celestial cultivators at Alien Labs met the deep forest dwellers at Talking Terps within an astral glade - Brainwash is the result of years of carefully considered deep tissue mind massages for your cerebral cortex. The smell places you in a spice market at noontime, seeking shade under the eaves of a hookah joint - herbal, sweet, citrusy, and minty in the slow swirl of heat. Densely enfolding verdant pyramids, tinted with purple, hide peaks and valleys with fractal dimension above 3.6 and spiritual dimensions only the 4th eye can comprehend. Spicy and buttery on pull, with a sweetness that sits on the tongue and gives way to herbal, earthy, slightly tangy notes on the exhale. A very potent hybrid - sedating, calming, and mind-wandering, without overwhelming distraction. Perfect for a Friday slide into the weekend or a mellow ramp up to a more charged evening outing. name: Gascotti | Indoor | 3.5g
description:
Gascotti | Indoor | 3.5g

Gascotti comes through loud and unmistakable. Dense, spongey buds shine with a silvery, wet frost over layers of lime and forest green, threaded with rusty orange pistils. The jar opens with a sharp rush of mentholated gas. Crack a nug and it only gets louder, coating the senses with fuel-forward funk and a subtle creamy sweetness underneath. On the inhale, pine and kerosene hit fast with immediate lung expansion. The exhale softens into floral lavender and a light powdered sugar finish, where the Biscotti influence lingers. Heavy, wave-like effects follow. A euphoric head change lifts the mood before melting into deep, full body relaxation, making Gascotti an ideal end of day smoke for experienced consumers.

name: Silver Spoon | Indoor | 3.5g
description:
Silver Spoon | Indoor | 3.5g

Silver Spoon is Connected building something new from their own genetics - crossing Super Silver Haze with two different phenotypes of Xeno to produce a sativa-dominant hybrid that has the familiarity of a classic and the surprise of something you haven't smoked before. The lineage tells the story: SSL brings the haze legacy of the late 90s California scene; Xeno brings the Z and mint character that made it a staple in the Connected catalog. Together they produce a strain that opens pungently gassy and sour, with sweet mint high notes rising above it all. The visual is striking - layered trichomes so dense the buds almost feel reluctant to be ground. Effects are energetic and social from the jump, with a cerebral quality that keeps things sharp and lively. Terpinolene dominant, limonene-lifted: this is a daytime, get-going strain built for movement and conversation.

description:
Blue Zushi | Jar Flower | 3.5g

Blue Zushi is an exotic indica-dominant hybrid that delivers a premium sushi-inspired experience with deeply relaxing effects as refined and satisfying as its unique lineage. This sophisticated cultivar begins with a gentle cerebral uplift that brings happiness, stress relief, and mild euphoria before flowing into a profoundly calming body high that soothes tension while maintaining comfortable mental awareness. Blue Zushi features an intriguing flavor profile dominated by sweet berry and creamy notes perfectly balanced with hints of earthy spice, subtle citrus, and delicate floral undertones that create a smooth, complex experience with each exhale. The aroma is equally captivating, presenting prominent berry and sweet cream scents layered with earthy richness, light citrus, and herbal notes that become more pronounced when the colorful, purple-hued, trichome-rich buds are broken apart. Medical cannabis patients particularly value Blue Zushi for its effectiveness in managing stress, anxiety, mild pain, and insomnia while promoting happiness, gentle relaxation, and restful sleep—ideal for evening use or any time when soothing mood enhancement and comfortable physical relief are desired.

Feelings: Happy, Relaxed, Sleepy

White Durban | Sativa Genetic

Bright, uplifting, and built for momentum, Waavy White Durban delivers a clean sativa experience that keeps your mind sharp and your energy moving. Grown indoors under tightly controlled conditions, this premium flower is all about clarity, flavor, and feel good focus.

name: Chemdog l LIVE ROSIN | 510 Cart .5g
description:
Chemdog l Live Rosin 510 Cart .5g

Chemdog is one of the godfathers of modern cannabis history — the genetic backbone of Sour Diesel, OG Kush, and GMO/Garlic Cookies among others. It’s the second of the MFNY Classics that pay homage to the strains that shaped modern cannabis — and the highs they first brought us. MFNY Classics aren’t throwbacks, they’re living proof of what we can do by infusing old-school cultivars with modern processes. All to bring legendary, full-of-life flavors and effects to New Yorkers.
At MFNY, we make RiverwayTM Live Rosin in a specific way that preserves powerful plant characteristics. We do this to highlight the difference between “real” live rosin and misleading alternatives on store shelves. Riverway isn’t just a name, it’s a promise to make products all New Yorkers can be proud of.
The Riverway Live Rosin Vape has a high terpene profile of our single-source, in-house produced Chemdog Riverway Live Rosin. We use a proprietary cultivation, freezing, and extraction process designed to preserve flavor, maximize potency, and ensure a truly solventless experience. This solventless extract showcases the cultivar’s naturally produced full-spectrum cannabinoids and remarkable terpenes. Upon the first inhale of MFNY’s Chemdog, your pallet will be met with a striking chemical and funk taste with undertones of earthiness; known to promote an euphoric body high with long-lasting, invigorating cerebral effects that spread to your whole body. No distillates, added flavors, or alterations.
Comes in a 510 Cart with recommended battery settings 2.8 - 3.3V. Do not vaporize live rosin at higher temperatures, as it can “burn off” the precious terpenes and aromas we are working hard to preserve; higher temps can also cause an undesirable “burnt” aftertaste. Vape cartridge contains concentrated live rosin oil that is heated by a battery and vaporized for inhalation. These products are very potent and are designed to be consumed in 2-3 second puffs.

name: Rhum Cake | 3.5g Flower
description:
Rhum Cake, is a hybrid of Wedding Cake and SunFuel, offering a sweet aroma and smooth icing fuel flavor, blending gas and rum vanilla cream. This gem has a darker green hue and bright orange hairs and coated in thick white crystals. This Indica-leaning hybrid guarantees a unique relaxing experience, reminiscent of savoring the finest confections from Kingston's esteemed Baker.
Rhum Cake is more than just a premium strain, it's a sensory journey deeply rooted in the soul of Jamaica. Infused with the island’s rich vibes and the enduring spirit of Rastafari culture, every bud tells a story. The Baker who holds it down at the Cake

Shop dispensary on legendary Orange Street, this strain is born from tradition and the essence of the Rastafari culture. Working hand-in-hand with the ever-watchful Screw Face, the duo forms the right and left hands of King Clementine, the mastermind of the herb scene in Jamaica. Their operation stretches far beyond city corners all across the map. Deep in the bush, Dreaddie cultivates fire herbs, while Queen Kushite, regal and grounded, tends to the Gully. From hills to kitchens, every leaf and bud of Rhum Cake is touched by purpose, community, and High Vibration intention. This is Rhum Cake, a strain steeped in Legacy, Loyalty, and the Highest Grade.

Genetics & Breeder Overview for Rhum Cake
• Genus: Indica dominant Hybrid

o A finely balanced hybrid leaning toward indica traits. Rhum Cake delivers a soothing body high with a clear-headed, uplifting cerebral experience—ideal for users who want both mental clarity and physical calm.

• Genetics: Wedding Cake x SunFuel
o Wedding Cake Famous for its rich dessert-like flavor, creamy vanilla, and tangy undertones. Known to deliver powerful euphoria and deep physical relaxation. A favorite among those seeking stress and pain relief with a sweet, dense smoke.

o SunFuel is a sativa-leaning hybrid celebrated for its uplifting and focused high, with gassy, citrus, and pine-forward notes. It brings vibrant energy and clarity, balancing Wedding Cake’s heavier indica effects with a refreshing cerebral spark.

• Breeder: Heavyweight Heads
o Renowned for producing premium top-shelf cannabis strains that deliver both extremely flavorful and powerful effects. Heavyweight Heads is committed to high-quality genetics and robust terpene profiles. True champions in their craft.
Top Terpenes & Effects
Terpenes:
1. ß-Myrcene
o Effect: Provides a relaxing effect while enhancing the flavor with earthy, herbal undertones.
o Aroma: Musky, earthy, and sometimes a bit spicy, adding depth to Island Sunshines’s flavor profile.
2. Caryophyllene
o Effect: Known for its anti-inflammatory and pain-relieving properties. Offers a soothing body effect without heavy sedation.
o Aroma: Spicy and peppery, with a warm woody kick, brings a bold and grounding edge to the flavor.
3. D-Limonene
o Effect: Uplifting and anti-anxiety refreshing profile.
o Aroma: Bright, citrusy, and zesty, it’s the perfect complement to the clementine flavor
Effects:
• Mental: Euphoric, focused, and mood-lifting. Rhum Cake delivers creative stimulation and mental clarity without overactivation, making it perfect for daytime focus or inspired sessions.
• Body: Smooth and calming. Provides light body relaxation and stress relief without inducing couch-lock or
drowsiness. Great for staying active while feeling at ease.
• Best For: Creative projects, Daytime stress management, Outdoor adventures, Social settings, Mood enhancement without brain fog.

Left Coast’s 3G Dual Chamber vape combines three unique terpene-rich strains infused with Liquid Diamonds & Live Resin for a layered flavor experience that evolves with every switch. The juicy tropical sweetness of Watermelon Mojito, and the candy-like burst of Blue Razz, this triple-chamber device lets you customize every session with the perfect balance of flavor, potency, and mood.
Skywalker OG delivers earthy pine, citrus, and classic OG fuel undertones for a smooth, heavy-hitting inhale, while Watermelon Mojito adds refreshing watermelon-citrus sweetness with icy tropical notes. Blue Razz finishes the experience with bold berry candy flavor and a sweet tangy exhale that keeps every hit flavorful and smooth

Left Coast 3G Dual Chamber How to Guide
1 Click: 1 flavor
2 Clicks: Mix 2 flavors
3 Clicks: Activate all 3 flavors
Hold 2 Seconds: Change voltage level
5 Clicks: Temporary Triple Flavor Mode

Recharge with a USB-C cable
Screen displays battery status while charging

The smart display shows:
Active flavor mode
Battery level
Puff count
Voltage level

“BLINKERS” animations during use
The BLINKERS display activates animated lighting effects while puffing and switching modes for an interactive experience. The screen automatically turns off after a few seconds to save battery life.

name: Chemdog x Chemdog | Live Rosin | 2.5g Bagel Hole
description:
Chemdog x Chemdog | Live Rosin | 2.5g Bagel Hole

DIRECTIONS:
Step 1: Make sure you’re sitting down with a group, because this is going to be a party. If all steps are followed correctly, the Bagel Hole should last between 30 to 45 minutes.

Step 2 While slowly rotating the roll, use a lighter to carefully light the outer edge of the end.

Step 3 Gently peel away the burnt rolling paper from the edge and end of the pre-roll.

Step 4 Rotating the roll, evenly light the outer edge until red coals develop.

Step 5 To burn evenly, it’s crucial to slowly and softly draw smoke for 1 to 2 seconds with at least 30 seconds between hits. Drawing from the Bagel roll too hard, or too quickly between hits will cause the flower to burn faster than the Rosin core can vaporize. This can lead to uneven, burning, clogging, and an overall less enjoyable experience.

name: 2PK LIVE RESIN | Sour Diesel | .5g 510 Cart
description:
2PK LIVE RESIN | Sour Diesel | .5g 510 Cart

"MFNY Classics are writing a new chapter in the history of cannabis, paying homage to the cultivars that shaped modern cannabis and the highs they first brought us. Rather than simply reviving names, we work with restored heirloom genetics, cultivated with intention and precision in conditions optimized to the plant’s needs, preserving and showcasing these important cultivars as they were meant to be experienced and bringing their legendary, full-of-life flavors and effects to a new generation of New Yorkers.
MF-ing Two-Fer: We're now offering two 1/2g carts in one bag. Why? Pouring less oil into each cart means we can preserve more of the plant's full spectrum cannabinoids, remarkable natural terpenes and fuller flavor. Not only that, the Two-Fer is better value and more of our single-source, in-house produced sour Diesel real live resin: Upon the first inhale of MFNY’s Sour Diesel, your pallet will be met with a deep diesel fuel and skunk that eventually gives way to a sour cream exhale; known to promote an focused head high with long-lasting, invigorating cerebral effects that spread to your whole body. No distillates, added flavors, or alterations.
Comes in a 510 Cart with recommended battery settings 2.8 - 3.3V. Do not vaporize live resin at higher temperatures, as it can “burn off” the precious terpenes and aromas we are working hard to preserve; higher temps can also cause an undesirable “burnt” aftertaste. Vape cartridge contains concentrated live resin oil that is heated by a battery and vaporized for inhalation. These products are very potent and are designed to be consumed in 2-3 second puffs."

 Tourbillon is a sativa-dominant hybrid from Aficionado Seeds that was personally selected by breeder Leo out of a 360-plant sift, which tells you everything you need to know about how seriously this strain was crafted. A cross of Biscotti with a complex blend of Triangle Kush, Cherry Pie Kush, and Grateful Breath, Tourbillon expresses deep OG and Cherry Pie Kush character without any of the typical Gelato softness you might expect from a Biscotti cross. description:
Apple Fritter | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

 Apple Fritter is a true hybrid classic from Lumpy's Flowers in Northern California, bred from Sour Apple and Animal Cookies by Jason Dias in 2013, and it quickly became one of the most recognized strains in craft cannabis for good reason. The buds are dense and covered in a thick blanket of trichomes with a rich apple pastry aroma that fills the room with notes of sweet green apple, spice, and a warm bakery undertone layered over an earthy, slightly gassy base. The smoke is smooth and complex with a tart apple character on the inhale that gives way to spicy, herbal earthiness on the exhale. The high is balanced and versatile, delivering a mood-lifting euphoria alongside a pleasant, grounding body relaxation that works as well for creative afternoons as it does for unwinding evenings.

description:
Cap Junky | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Cap Junky is the result of a landmark collaboration between two of the most respected names in modern cannabis breeding, Capulator and Seed Junky Genetics, and the result is exactly as good as that pedigree suggests. A cross of Alien Cookies and Kush Mints #11, Cap Junky produces dense, trichome-drenched buds with a complex aroma of gas, fermented fruit, pine, and a cool minty sharpness that cuts right through the funk. The flavor on the inhale leans sour and fruity before shifting to a peppery, smooth exhale with a lingering sweetness that keeps you coming back. The high is powerful and well-rounded, opening with euphoric mental clarity and a wave of creative energy before settling into a deep full-body relaxation that never quite tips into sedation.

name: Honey Banana | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Honey Banana | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Honey Banana is exactly what it sounds like: sweet, sticky, and satisfying. Bred from Strawberry Banana and Honey Boo Boo by Elemental Seeds, this heavy-handed hybrid delivers buds so coated in resin they glisten like fresh honeycomb. The aroma rolls out in warm waves of ripe banana, tropical fruit, and natural honey with a subtle earthy base that keeps it grounded. The flavor stays true to the nose through and through, and the effects hit with a weighty full-body calm balanced by a bright cerebral buzz that leaves you giggly, content, and floating somewhere pleasant. It is the kind of strain that turns a quiet evening into a good one.

Amherst Sour Diesel is a sativa-dominant powerhouse that was made popular in WNY, bringing together Chemdawg genetics with Amherst Super Skunk to create a strain that honors the classic diesel tradition while adding its own distinct West Coast character. The buds are dense and resin-coated, releasing an intoxicating blend of pungent diesel, tropical fruit, and exotic wood the moment the jar opens. On the inhale the flavor comes through rich and gassy with bright fruity undertones, and the high follows quickly with an uplifting, long-lasting cerebral buzz that keeps energy and mood elevated for hours. Everybody has tried a cut of the original Sour Diesel but have you tried the Western NY version?

Cake Bomb | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

Cake Bomb is a rare and potent indica-dominant hybrid from Prolific Coast Seeds, built on the formidable genetics of Do-Si-Dos crossed with PCS1, a complex blend that includes WiFi3 and a powerful pairing of Scott's OG and Casper OG. The buds glisten with frosty trichomes and give off a captivating aroma of sweet bakery, earthy depth, and a fuel-forward OG funk that announces its lineage before you even light up. On the smoke it delivers bold notes of lemon zest, woody sweetness, and a slightly minty spice before settling into one of the more satisfying body highs this side of the menu. The high arrives fast, opens with a wave of euphoric uplift, and then transitions into a full, relaxing body buzz that is hard to argue with.

The smoke is smooth and indulgent, tasting like a dessert you cannot put down, and the indica-dominant high wraps around you slowly and completely, easing muscle tension, calming the mind, and guiding you into a state of pure relaxed contentment. This is your end-of-day reward, your Friday night unwinding companion, your reason to just slow down.

Solventless "Dad" Hash - Traditional hash made from single source material grown in New York.

Experience nostalgia with our Solventless "Dad Hash" - a modern twist on the classic bricked hash your dad used to enjoy, now crafted with premium genetics and cutting-edge technology.

Solventless hash is produced from dried and cured flower. The flower is frozen and agitated in an ice water bath to remove the trichrome heads, the trichrome/water mixture is then passed through a series of screens to isolate the most desirable parts of the plant (cannabinoids and terpenes). Once the hash has been produced it is dried, sieved, and packaged for retail sales.

Put simply, RSO is an oil derived from cannabis. But rather than a solvent extract that strips trichomes from buds, RSO contains all the cannabinoids, terpenes, and additional compounds of the whole cannabis plant. The extraction process is complex and fairly long, similar to making a tincture.

name: Lil Leftys Grape Cookies | Infused Blunts 1.3g 5 pack | 6.5g
description:
Lil Leftys Grape Cookies | Infused Blunts 1.3g 5 pack | 6.5g

Grape Cookies offers smokers what might be described as a “creeper” of a high, taking as many as 10 to 15 minutes to reveal its effects. As the high sets in, the user may note inexplicable feelings of euphoria and positivity. This upbeat emotional state is accompanied by an odd pressure around the temples and cheeks. As users become accustomed to these newfound sensations, they can also detect some significant changes in their perception. Certain sights and sounds may take on a new intensity that can occupy the smoker’s attention for quite a while. Many consumers also describe a palpable feeling of time dilation or a visual warping of depth perception. In addition to these sensory novelties, Grape Cookies brings about a slight increase in mental stimulation. Thoughts and ideas may flow more quickly than usual and may take on a new, ineffable significance. Far from cerebral, though, Grape Cookies is unlikely to leave users acute enough to execute complicated analytical tasks; this is not a strain for enhancing productivity. Instead, the bud’s head high is dreamy and lazy, especially as its bodily effects become more pronounced. As the high progresses, waves of relaxation roll down the neck and spread through the spine and core. This sedation may inspire users to take a load off in the closest comfortable surroundings. Under the right circumstances, Grape Cookies can cause both couch-lock and sleep. For these reasons, the strain is best enjoyed at night. Grape Cookies can also have therapeutic value for medical cannabis patients. Its sedation can soothe aches and pains, whether they’re temporary, as due to injury, or chronic, as due to conditions like fibromyalgia and arthritis. As noted, the strain can also lull consumers into a deep and fulfilling sleep. Psychologically speaking, it can even temporarily take the edge off of stress, depression, and anxiety.

There’s a reason Orange Creamsicle is such a great strain for new users. It’s a great example of the prototypical cannabis experience. It comes on in five to ten minutes, with a gentle head high that encourages free association, creative thoughts, and calming of tension. It’s not going to generate a euphoric, intense high, but it’s an easy strain to use during the day or when you need to get other things done at the same time.

The Orange Creamsicle strain’s body buzz is equally mild. Over the course of the buzz, you’ll notice your muscles slowly relaxing and tension melting away. There’s no couchlock or sedation, so it’s just as useful for daytime use as it is as a method to unwind at the end of the day. In fact, many users of Orange Creamsicle weed use it as an easy way to keep their mood and their muscle even all day long.

This is also the case for medical marijuana users. The mild but noticeable effects of the strain don’t interrupt your normal functions, so people with anxiety and depression can use it as a pick-me-up while still achieving their goals for the day. Dark thoughts are muted and worries aren’t as worrying while Orange Creamsicle is in effect.

description:

Versatile, uplifting, and built for clarity, Waavy Night Owl Haze is a smooth sativa designed to keep you focused, creative, and engaged any time of day. Grown indoors under precise conditions, this premium flower delivers steady energy and mental clarity without feeling overwhelming or jittery.

Night Owl offers a clean cerebral lift that supports focus, conversation, and creative flow while keeping the body light and relaxed. It fits seamlessly into daytime productivity, social sessions, creative work, or moments when you want to stay inspired and present without burnout.

Carefully hand trimmed and slow cured to preserve terpene expression, Night Owl Haze reflects Waavy’s commitment to premium indoor quality and a consistently smooth, flavorful smoke.

Why You’ll Love It
Sativa dominant effects with clear, uplifting energy
Smooth, balanced experience suitable for any time of day
Clean smoke with a focused, creative feel
Great for productivity, social settings, and creative moments

Flavor Profile:
A bright burst of candied citrus leads the experience, with zesty lemon and sour notes sparkling on the palate. Soft, flowery undertones add a delicate balance, while waves of sugary sweetness build and linger, finishing clean, vibrant, and irresistibly sweet-tart.

Aroma Profile:
A lively rush of citrus and sour brightness rises first, softened by sweet, floral notes that drift through the nose. Earthy and herbal layers ground the aroma, while a classic haze character weaves through the profile, creating a fresh yet complex bouquet that’s both uplifting and deeply aromatic.

Top Effects: 
Aroused, Creative, Euphoria, Tingly, Uplifted, Focused

Tricho Jordan is a great choice for experienced consumers looking for a strong, long-lasting smoke that leans heavily into relaxation and recovery.

description:
1996 Albany Sour Diesel | Indoor Flower | 3.5g

The 96 Sour Diesel is not just a strain name but a timestamp, representing one of the most legendary and influential East Coast cannabis clones to ever circulate through the underground. Originating from the New York scene in the mid-1990s, this sativa-dominant cut became the gold standard for diesel genetics worldwide, and its reputation has only grown over the decades. The aroma hits immediately with sharp, fuel-forward pungency layered with citrus rind, skunk, and a slightly piney chemical edge that is unmistakable. The high is just as bold, arriving fast with a clear, energizing cerebral rush that lifts mood, sharpens focus, and keeps you moving through the day without a hint of drag.
